What every prophet taught

That Day

No soul owns anything for another that Day. The command is God's, and His mercy stays.

On that Day, the things that rank us here fall away: wealth, children, family name. No soul owns anything for another, the Quran says, and the command is God's, to whom all intercession belongs. What helps is what we bring: a sound heart, faith and good deeds. Each person has what they strove for. It is level ground for every human being, and over it stands God's mercy, which no one need despair of.

﴿يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

Quran · Al-Infitar 82:19

﴿يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ٨٨ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ٨٩﴾

Translation of the meaning

The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

Quran · Ash-Shu'ara 26:88-89

﴿وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

Quran · An-Najm 53:39

﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

Quran · Al-Kahf 18:110

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:53

You might ask

QuestionCan anyone speak for me on that Day?
AnswerThe Quran says all intercession belongs to God, and none speaks before Him except by His leave. So hope turns to Him, now and then.Quran · Az-Zumar 39:44
QuestionWhat will help me on that Day?
AnswerWhat you bring to God: a sound heart. The Quran says wealth and children do not help then, and it joins faith to good deeds throughout.Quran · Ash-Shu'ara 26:88-89
QuestionWho is safe from loss?
AnswerThe Quran keeps it short: those who believe, do good, and urge one another to truth and patience. Anyone can join them.Quran · Al-Asr 103:3

Bring a sound heart and good deeds, and hope in His mercy.
